title: Strict exchange carries the normalized source quotient augmentation
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $I$ a finitely generated ideal, with $A/I$ additive torsion and $P_n=A/I^n$ finite and perfect over $A$ for $n\geq1$. On the small pro-etale site of each scheme $T$ put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(P_n)_T$, and use its ordinary unbounded module derived category and strict reduction towers [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $\square=(f:X\to Y,f':X'\to Y',g:Y'\to Y,g':X'\to X)$ be cartesian, with $f$ proper [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let $K\in D(A_X)$ and $C=Rf_{*,A}K$ be derived $I$-complete, and retain compatible witnesses $L_n\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},P_n)$ and $\alpha_n:\nu_X^*L_n\simeq K\otimes^L_{A_X}(P_n)_X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Set $E_0=Lg_A'^*K$, $M=Lg_A^*C$, $N=Rf'_{*,A}E_0$, and let $e:M\to N$ be the actual ambient mate [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange].
For any corner $T$ let $\Delta_T$ be constant strict towers and define $\mathcal R_T(V)=\Delta_TV\otimes^L_{\Delta_TA_T}((P_n)_T)_n$, with its quotient augmentation $i_V:\Delta_TV\to\mathcal R_T(V)$. Put $F_T=R\lim_T$ [prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality], let $\lambda_V:V\to F_T\Delta_TV$ be the canonical constant-tower map, and set $u_V=F_T(i_V)\lambda_V$.
Use the actual towers $B_\bullet,D_\bullet$, arrow $v'_\bullet$, and source comparison $s:S\simeq F_{Y'}B_\bullet$ in [def-weil-pbc-completed-base-change-map], with $S=Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}C$ and specified unit $\gamma_g:M\to S$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Let $\tau_g:Lg^*_{\mathrm{Tow}}\mathcal R_Y(C)\simeq\mathcal R_{Y'}(M)$ be the normalized reduction/pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-reduction-pullback-derived-tower], and put $j=F_{Y'}(\tau_g)$. Let $H:\mathcal R_{Y'}(M)\simeq B_\bullet$ and $H':\mathcal R_{Y'}(N)\simeq D_\bullet$ be exactly the diagram-site projection comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-tower-exchange-mate-normalization]. Then
$$j\gamma_g=u_M,\qquad s=F_{Y'}(H)j,\qquad F_{Y'}(\mathcal R_{Y'}(e))u_M=u_Ne,$$
and the actual strict exchange satisfies
$$F_{Y'}(v'_\bullet)s\gamma_g=F_{Y'}(H')u_Ne.$$
All comparisons include the retained witness transports and strict quotient transitions. These are equalities of derived morphisms obtained from the specified strict maps; no faithfulness of derived evaluation, invertibility of $e$, invertibility of $v'_\bullet$, or invertibility of $\gamma_g$ is assumed.
